affiliations.date_precision: Civilian-occupation code 525 recorded on the Army merged-file row dated 17 February 1941; no employer, workplace, trade specialty, or OSS-entry date is established by the accessible sources.
affiliations.research_notes: The exact private identifier and exact full name confirm the Army record. The occupation is not an employer. A restricted 1944 Hoover item is a promising chronology lead but was not used as final evidence.

affiliations.date_precision: A 2009 obituary places the uncommon exact-name individual in this Durham role during a prewar chronology; the 1940 directory independently lists John A. Creedy in Durham as an editor, but neither source gives employment dates.
affiliations.research_notes: The exact indexed name, directory entry, and obituary chronology support only a probable identity. The affiliation is not normalized to a canonical organization because the retrospective newspaper wording requires historical-title review.

claims.temporal_assessment: Documented on an Army row dated 17 February 1941; it is prewar but is not proven to be the immediately pre-OSS occupation.
claims.match_notes: Occupation is not employer. A reading-room-only Hoover item may clarify the Army-to-OSS chronology, but search-indexed OCR is not used as final evidence.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The index prints Robert N. Creadick with a literal six-digit value. That suffix occurs on eight unrelated Army rows, and the one Robert Creadick Army name candidate has middle initial H rather than N. A later Durham physician namesake lacks an OSS, Box 153, or private-identifier bridge.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 153 to interpret the literal six-digit value and test the Durham physician and Army namesakes. No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked index identifies Charles C. Creamer in Box 153 without rank or private identifier. person_updates.next_action: Review Box 153 to establish Charles C. Creamer's identity, personnel status, immediate pre-OSS affiliation, and last civilian employer. No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified.
